items.description:
Kings Meat Deli is a butchery and delicatessen whose own website describes a selection of premium quality meats, artisan charcuterie and gourmet specialty items for discerning customers. The business says it began as a small family butchery at Castle Walk Shopping Centre in 1995, and it has grown from those roots into a deli that pairs fresh meat with specialty products.

This branch trades from Lynnwood Bridge, on the corner of Lynnwood Road and Daventry Street in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria. Lynnwood is an established eastern suburb of the city, and the centre gives nearby households a convenient place to shop. It suits home cooks who want quality cuts, charcuterie for the table and gourmet deli extras from a butchery with a long family history. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, and Saturday from 8am to 3pm, and Sunday from 9am to 1pm.

items.description:
Bismillah Restaurant serves halaal South Asian food, drawing on the cooking of Bangladesh, Pakistan and south-east India. Its website says authentic ingredients are used and that the chefs, who come from Bangladesh, carry the culinary knowledge and tradition behind dishes full of aroma, colour and masala. The menu includes biryani, tikka, korma, roti, curry and niharee, and the site also lists a specials page and catering and functions, with a community hall alongside the restaurant.

The restaurant is at Shop 3, on the corner of 9th Avenue and Tangerine Street in Laudium, the well-known suburb on the western side of Pretoria. It is a good fit for families, groups and event hosts looking for halaal curry and traditional spicy dishes. It is open Monday to Sunday from 10am to 10pm.

items.description:
Packall Stationery describes itself as a convenience store for all stationery and office supplies, and as a proudly South African business that offers both wholesaling and retailing. Its product range covers arts and crafts, ball and gel pens, board and paper, calculators, calendars and diaries, computer accessories, envelopes, files and storage, labels, office accessories and packaging, with facility management supplies listed as well. The store can be browsed online as well as visited, and it positions itself on pricing for both individual buyers and bulk customers.

It is based at 201 Edward Avenue in Zwartkop, Centurion, in the Tshwane area between Pretoria and Johannesburg. It suits offices, schools and households that want one place to stock up on everyday stationery. It is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:15pm, and Friday from 7:30am to 2:45pm.

items.description:
DealersOnline presents itself as a vehicle valuation and auction specialist rather than a showroom. Its website says it helps clients stay ahead of the used car market with specialist software products and disposal solutions, supporting digital-first sales channels that run business to business, direct to consumer, consumer to business and business to consumer. It says it facilitates the disposal of over 5000 vehicles a month, including collection, storage and release, and that it uses dealership networks, online marketplaces and remarketing expertise to improve returns on fleet vehicles and other business assets. Valuation experience is built into digitised workflows and automated processes.

The business operates from 26 Sterling Road in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, and suits fleet owners, dealers and companies disposing of vehicles or assets. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm.

Dial a Bed Southdowns is a bed and mattress store at Southdowns Shopping Centre, 1 Karee Street, Irene, near Centurion. The store page lists a 100 Night Comfort Exchange, delivery information and finance through TFG Money, and shows the branch trading Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, on Saturday from 09:00 to 15:00 and on Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 13:00.

Customers who left Google reviews gave the branch a rating of 5.0 across 19 reviews, mentioning patient and knowledgeable staff, advice on keeping a mattress performing well and a delivery that arrived ahead of the date promised. It is a good fit for shoppers in Centurion and Irene who want to try beds in person and talk through the options with the team.

items.description:
Afri-Chair is a manufacturer of plastic products that says it specialises in plastic chairs, buckets, oval buckets, baby chairs, kitchenware and cooler boxes. The range on its website also includes basins, portable toilets, laundry baskets, ironing boards, a 70 litre dustbin, jerry cans and builders products, and it is made from both virgin and recycled plastic. The company states that it works by the motto of producing and delivering fine quality products at the best prices to the whole nation. Visitors to the site can download a full brochure as a PDF and request a quote.

The factory address is 350 Alwyn Street in Waltloo, an industrial area in eastern Pretoria. It suits retailers, builders and households looking for durable everyday plastic goods. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

items.description:
Rise Luxury Massage Spa offers massage and wellness treatments in Garsfontein Extension 10, in the east of Pretoria. Its website describes a calm space meant as an escape from everyday stress, with a range of massage therapies from traditional Swedish massage to deep tissue treatments, tailored by the therapists to each guest. The menu also includes complementary treatments such as facials and body scrubs, so guests can combine relaxation with skin care. The spa says it believes in holistic wellness and aims for both physical rejuvenation and mental relaxation, whether a guest is easing muscle tension or simply wants quiet time.

It is based at 938 Poolhond Avenue and suits residents of Pretoria East looking for a relaxing treatment or a pampering outing. It is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 7pm, and Sunday from 9am to 6pm.

items.description:
Countwiz Consulting has provided bookkeeping, financial statements, business consulting and statutory submission services since 1999. Its website lists core services including business startup support, which takes the non-money-generating tasks off a new owner's hands, complete accounting from bookkeeping to financial statements and custom management reporting, and independent reviews of financial statements for clients who prefer to use their own auditors. The firm also analyses a client's systems, processes and workflows in its business consulting work, and lists statutory services, assurance and investigations, and sustainability. It supports accounting software including Sage 300 ERP, Sage CRM, Spindle Professional and QuickBooks Online, with a ticket system for Sage 300 support.

The office is at 330 Spitskop Road in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, and suits small and growing businesses. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 4pm.

Cresco Solutions is an accounting practice in Centurion that offers bookkeeping, payroll administration and taxation services. Its website says it turns balance sheets into business stories, built on clarity, compliance and confidence. The bookkeeping service covers the systematic recording of financial transactions and regular reconciliation with third-party accounts. Payroll is offered as a complete outsourced solution so that employees are paid accurately and on time while the business keeps up with changing legislation. The tax service focuses on SARS compliance and strategic tax planning, so that individuals and businesses pay what is legally required and avoid penalties and interest.

The practice is at Unit B16, Inside Out Campus on Lenchen Avenue in Amberfield, Centurion, and suits owner-managed businesses that want to outsource their finances. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4pm, and Friday from 8am to 1pm.

Dial a Bed Six Fountains is a bed and mattress store at the corner of Bendeman Boulevard and Ferreira Street, listed under the Silverlakes and Six Fountains area of Pretoria. The branch page shows it open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00, on Saturday from 09:00 to 15:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 13:00.

Google reviews give the store a rating of 4.5 from 17 reviews, with customers praising the service they received on a first bed purchase and crediting the sales team with the knowledge and expertise that helped them choose. The store promotes beds and mattresses from well-known South African bed brands. It suits couples, families and first-time buyers in the Pretoria East estates who prefer to shop in person.

items.description:
4IRSA TECH describes 4IRSA as a platform that creates space for dialogue, understanding and action to shape a coherent plan for the fourth industrial revolution in South Africa. Its website says the platform brings together stakeholders, decision makers and pioneers to define the principles, visions and outcomes of Industry 4.0, and to discuss best practices and solutions to the challenges it raises. The industries it highlights are construction, mining and security, and its listed services include skills transfer through education and training. The site also offers downloads for Windows and Mac.

The business is based at 1242 Ruimsig Crescent in Woodhill Golf Estate, Pretoria East. It will interest companies and professionals who want to understand how digital technology is changing their industry. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
